name: How long does concrete foundation repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does concrete foundation repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of concrete foundation repair depends on the complexity and scale of the project. Simple crack repairs might be completed in a single day. More extensive work, such as installing piers or significant slab jacking, can take anywhere from a few days to a couple of weeks. Factors like weather conditions, property accessibility, and the specific repair method chosen can also influence the timeline. Your contractor can provide a more precise schedule after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from one day for simple cracks to a few days or weeks for extensive work, depending on project complexity.
